scene.description: A vibrant, sun-drenched coastal scene in the style of a high-resolution professional photograph taken with a reflex camera in an open, natural setting. The image captures a romantic, leisurely moment between a young couple walking along a seaside promenade, with the iconic, colorful cliffside town of Positano (Italy) cascading up the mountainside behind them. The camera is positioned at eye level, slightly low, capturing the couple as the central focus while framing the dramatic, colorful architecture of Positano in the background. The foreground features a terracotta pot with vibrant pink and red hibiscus flowers on a dark metal railing, adding a pop of color and texture. The midground includes outdoor café tables with wooden chairs, patrons seated and enjoying the view, and umbrellas casting soft shadows. The background is dominated by the terraced, pastel-colored houses clinging to the steep cliffside, with lush greenery and rocky outcrops. The sea stretches to the horizon on the left, with a few small boats visible. The sky is a clear, light blue with no clouds, enhancing the brightness and vibrancy of the scene.
